modal.title: Settings
modal.description: Models, agents, tools, skills, and connections used by PP Agent.

general.title: General
general.description: Your language, workspace, appearance, default model, and updates.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language used across the app.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Follow your system, or always use light or dark.

defaultModel.label: Default model
defaultModel.emptyHint: Connect a provider in Models to choose a default.
defaultModel.hint: Used for new chats. You can switch models in any chat from below the message box.

desktop.description: How PP Agent behaves next to your other apps.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.description: Tell me when an answer is ready or an action needs my approval while PP Agent is not in front.

tray.label: Tray icon
tray.description: Keep an icon in the menu bar or system tray. Closing the window then hides it and the app keeps running. To keep working with the app fully closed, use Settings › Background.

shortcut.label: Global shortcut
shortcut.description: Press a key combination anywhere to bring PP Agent to the front with the message box ready.
shortcut.hint: Modifiers and one key, for example CommandOrControl+Shift+Space.
shortcut.invalid: Not a valid shortcut. Use modifiers and one key, for example CommandOrControl+Shift+Space.

voice.title: Voice input
voice.description: Speak instead of typing: the microphone button in the message box turns your recording into text. It runs whisper.cpp on this computer, or sends the recording to a service you choose here.

provider.label: Provider
provider.help: Local speech to text needs no key and sends nothing anywhere. A provider or gateway from Models is used only when you pick it here.
provider.empty: No provider with a key yet. Local speech to text works without one.

local.modelHelp: The whisper model to run on this computer. Smaller models are faster; larger ones handle accents and noise better.
local.missingBinary: whisper.cpp is not installed. Install it (for example `brew install whisper-cpp`) and restart PP Agent.
local.privacy: The recording stays on this computer.

model.label: Model
model.help: The speech-to-text model, for example whisper-1.

language.label: Spoken language
language.help: Telling the service the language makes the text more accurate.

voice.notReady: Not ready: download the local model, or choose a provider that has a key.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Short notes the agent keeps across conversations, such as your preferences. They are added to every new conversation as information, never as instructions. Each note is remembered everywhere or in one workspace only.

enable.label: Remember notes between conversations
enable.description: When off, no notes are shared with the agent and it cannot save new ones. Agents can also turn memory off for themselves.

form.textPlaceholder: For example: I prefer short answers in Vietnamese.

errors.textTooLong: A note can be at most {{max}} characters.
errors.scopeFull: That place already holds {{max}} notes. Delete one first.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this note?
deleteConfirm.description: The agent will no longer remember: “{{text}}”

clearConfirm.title: Delete all notes?
clearConfirm.description: The agent forgets everything it saved. This cannot be undone.

empty.title: No notes yet
empty.description: The agent saves notes when you ask it to remember something. You can also add them here.

memory.count_one: {{count}} note · up to {{max}} in each place
memory.count_other: {{count}} notes · up to {{max}} in each place

scheduledTasks.title: Scheduled tasks
scheduledTasks.description: Instructions the agent carries out on its own at set times. Each run is saved as a conversation you can read from the sidebar.

approval.title: Runs without you
approval.description: Nobody is there to say yes, so any action that needs your approval is skipped and noted in the conversation. Reading and actions you set to Allow still run. The app must be open at the scheduled time; a run missed while it was closed is made up once if it was due in the last 24 hours.

lastRun.denied_one: {{count}} action skipped: it needed your approval
lastRun.denied_other: {{count}} actions skipped: they needed your approval

scheduledTasks.runQueued: “{{name}}” is starting. Its conversation appears in the sidebar.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this task?
deleteConfirm.description: “{{name}}” stops running. Conversations it already created stay in your history.

empty.title: No scheduled tasks
empty.description: Create a task to have the agent do something regularly, such as summarizing your reports every Friday.

editor.subtitle: Choose what the agent does and when it does it.

notFound.title: Task not found
notFound.description: It may have been deleted. Go back to the list.

editor.name: Name
editor.promptPlaceholder: Read the files in the Reports folder and list anything that needs my attention.
editor.promptHelp: Write it as you would in a new chat. At most {{max}} characters.
editor.fallbackHelp: If the agent or workspace is deleted later, the default one is used.

when.atHelp: Run once at this local date and time. Existing one-shot tasks keep their exact scheduled instant unless you change it.

enabled.label: Turned on
enabled.description: When off, the task is kept but never starts by itself. You can still use Run now.

errors.nameRequired: Enter a name for the task.
errors.nameTaken: Another task already has this name.
errors.promptRequired: Write what the agent should do.
errors.interval: Use {{minMinutes}} to {{maxMinutes}} minutes, or 1 to {{maxHours}} hours.
errors.at: Enter a valid local date and time. Times repeated when the timezone clock moves back are ambiguous; choose a time outside the repeated interval.

background.title: Background
background.description: Keep the agent running after you close the window or quit the app.

service.title: Run in background
service.description: The agent keeps running when you close the window or quit the app. It answers your messages and carries out scheduled tasks on time. It starts by itself when you sign in to your computer.
service.on: On: the agent keeps running without the window.
service.off: Off: the agent stops when you quit the app.

unsupported.title: Not available on this computer
unsupported.fallback: This computer can't start the agent in the background.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Chat with the agent from messaging apps. Each channel answers only the one person you pair with it.

needsBackground.title: The agent has to be running to answer
needsBackground.description: Channels answer while PP Agent is open. To keep answering with the app closed, turn on Settings › Background.

approval.title: Approvals happen in the chat
approval.description: While a channel is on, anything the agent does that needs your approval is asked in that chat (Telegram has buttons; Zalo asks you to reply with a number). Tools set to “Always ask” in Settings › Tools can be approved there. Only the paired person can answer or give orders to the bot.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.description: Chat with the agent from the Telegram app on your phone, even when this window is closed.

enabled.label: Answer messages on Telegram
enabled.description: When off, the bot stays silent. Your settings are kept.

token.label: Bot token
token.placeholder: Saved. Paste a new token to replace it.
token.help: To get one, open Telegram, start a chat with @BotFather, send /newbot and follow the steps. It then gives you a token: paste it here.
token.required: Paste a bot token to turn Telegram on.

telegram.agentHelp: Who answers. “The workspace's agent” uses the agent set in the workspace, or the built-in one. /agent in the chat changes it.
telegram.workspaceHelp: Where the agent works. /workspace in the chat changes it and starts a new conversation.

pairing.needsSetup: Save a bot token and turn Telegram on first.
pairing.instructionNoBot: In Telegram, send {{command}} to your bot.
pairing.expired: This code has expired. Pair again to get a new one.

forget.title: Forget Telegram?
forget.description: The saved bot token and the paired person are removed, and the bot stops answering. You can set it up again at any time.

connect.title: 1. Connect your bot
connect.description: Create a bot with @BotFather in Telegram, then paste its token here.

pair.title: 2. Pair your account
pair.description: Only the person who pairs can talk to the bot. Anyone else is ignored.

replies.title: 3. Choose how it answers
replies.description: Choose where it works and who answers.

chats.title: Per-chat settings
chats.description: Configure access, busy mode and allowlist for each chat.

chats.empty: No chats configured. Add a private chat or group using its Telegram chat ID.
chats.chatIdHelp: Enter the numeric chat ID, not a username. Group and supergroup IDs are negative (for example, -1001234567890). The bot must be a member of the group to reply.
chats.label: Label (optional)
chats.labelHelp: A name shown only in these settings. Leave empty to show the chat ID.

errors.chatId: Enter a non-zero integer Telegram chat ID, including the minus sign for a group.
errors.duplicate: This chat is already configured. Edit its existing settings instead.
errors.allowedUsers: Enter positive integer Telegram user IDs separated by commas, or leave empty.

chats.allowedUsersHelp: Applies when anyone in the chat can talk: comma-separated Telegram user IDs. Empty allows everyone in the chat; owner-only access still allows only the paired owner.

zalo.title: Zalo
zalo.description: Chat with the agent from the Zalo app on your phone, even when this window is closed.

enabled.label: Answer messages on Zalo
enabled.description: When off, the bot stays silent. Your settings are kept.

token.label: Bot token
token.placeholder: Saved. Paste a new token to replace it.
token.placeholderEmpty: Paste the token Zalo sent you
token.help: To get one, open Zalo, find the official account “Zalo Bot Manager”, choose “Create bot”, and enter a name that starts with “Bot”. Zalo then sends you the token in a message: paste it here.
token.required: Paste a bot token to turn Zalo on.

zalo.agentHelp: Who answers. “The workspace's agent” uses the agent set in the workspace, or the built-in one. /agent in the chat changes it.
zalo.workspaceHelp: Where the agent works. /workspace in the chat changes it and starts a new conversation.

pairing.needsSetup: Save a bot token and turn Zalo on first.
pairing.instructionNoBot: In Zalo, send {{command}} to your bot.
pairing.expired: This code has expired. Pair again to get a new one.

forget.title: Forget Zalo?
forget.description: The saved bot token and the paired person are removed, and the bot stops answering. You can set it up again at any time.

connect.title: 1. Connect your bot
connect.description: Create a bot with “Zalo Bot Manager” in Zalo, then paste its token here.

pair.title: 2. Pair your account
pair.description: Only the person who pairs can talk to the bot. Anyone else is ignored.

replies.title: 3. Choose how it answers
replies.description: Choose where it works and who answers.

browserSection.title: Browser profiles
browserSection.description: The browser in the side panel keeps sign-ins per profile. Import cookies from a browser on this computer to stay signed in to the same sites.
browserSection.loadError: Browser profiles could not be loaded
browserSection.deleted: Deleted the profile {{name}} and its sign-ins.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this browser profile?
deleteConfirm.description: {{name}} and everything it keeps (sign-ins, cookies, site data) are removed from PP Agent. Your other browsers are not affected.

browserSection.privacy: Cookies are copied once and stay on this computer. Signing out here does not sign you out of the other browser.

import.title: Import cookies into {{name}}
import.description: Copies every cookie of a browser profile on this computer, so sites you are signed in to there are signed in here too. Cookies already in this profile with the same name are replaced.
import.hintMac: macOS will ask to allow access to the browser's saved key. Choose “Allow”.
import.hintWindows: If the import fails, quit that browser completely and try again.
import.hintFirefox: Cookies of container tabs and private windows are not copied.
import.none: No supported browser with saved cookies was found on this computer (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc, Chromium or Firefox).

computerSection.title: Computer use
computerSection.description: Lets the agent use apps on this computer: it reads what a window shows, then clicks, types and uses menus, usually without taking over your screen.
computerSection.risk: The agent can do in an app whatever you could do there. Text it reads in an app (an email, a chat) could try to trick it, so keep “acting asks first” unless you trust the task. The agent can never use PP Agent itself, terminals, or password and privacy settings.

enable.title: Let the agent use apps
enable.description: Looking at a window runs on its own. Clicking, typing and opening apps ask you first, unless you set the computer tool to run without asking in Settings › Tools.

status.title: Access
status.unsupported: Computer use is not available on this computer.
status.missing: PP Agent needs access to {{what}} in System Settings › Privacy & Security.
status.ready: PP Agent has the access it needs.
status.oneAtATime: macOS asks for one at a time: allow Accessibility first, then click Grant access again for Screen Recording.
status.restartHint: After you turn access on, quit and reopen PP Agent if it still shows as missing.

allowed.title: Always allowed
allowed.description: The agent may use these apps without asking you which app first. Clicking and typing in them still follow the setting above.
allowed.empty: No apps yet. Choose “Always allow” when the agent asks to use an app.

blocked.title: Blocked
blocked.description: The agent may never use these apps.

computerSection.loadError: Could not load the app lists
